subject: Urgent: Peregrine AI capacity pre-hold & sizing runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Peregrine AI — request: preliminary sizing + pre-hold

Ben / Marcus —

We have a late-stage commercial with Peregrine AI (deal id DEAL-9832). They verbally committed to a Q4 launch window and the customer engineering team just surfaced their target throughput: sustained generation at 1.2M tokens/day with spiky weekends (x2 peak). High level ask: can ops provide a validated sizing recommendation and a 30-day soft pre-hold on dedicated capacity while legal/procurement finish the MOU?

What I need from you:
- Marcus: a quick scan of available dedicated pools (us-west & us-east) and realistic conversion to H100-equivalent slots. Include recommended instance mix (e.g., 8xH100 or 16xA100), expected tail-latency impact, and an autoscale buffer.
- Ben / Marissa: I want a short mutual action plan to share with Peregrine that commits us to a soft hold and outlines the gating items (SOC2 evidence, MOU sign, PO).

Attaching the latest requirements doc from the customer (peregrine_capacity_requirements_v2.xlsx). I realize code-level perf still needs evaluation but the runway is tight — please treat as high priority.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2029 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine AI — request: preliminary sizing + pre-hold

Jonas / Ben —

Quick scan below (pulled from fleet inventory as of 2029-06-24 16:45 PDT). Attachment: gpu_pool_snapshot_20290624.csv (trimmed).

Summary of capacity options (us-west / us-east combined):
- Available headroom (no commitments): ~56 A100-40GB equivalents (node-level conversions done on vram & tensor throughput).
- Preferred dedicated reservation: 12xH100 (preferred for throughput stability) OR 24xA100 if customer insists on the A100 SKU mix.
- Throughput rationale: 12xH100 supports concurrent 8 pods (2 GPUs/pod) with room for autoscale to 16 pods using burst capacity, which should cover 1.2M tokens/day with room for latency SLAs.
- Buffer: recommend an operational buffer of +20% for the first 30 days (handles the weekend x2 spikes you described). That equates to a soft hold of 15 H100-equivalent slots.

Constraints & notes:
- If we reserve 15 H100-equivalents in us-west, we will push some flexible non-reserved jobs to preemptible/backfill pools; expected customer-visible impact is low if we keep KV cache primed.
- Tail-latency: with the requested sizing and proper batching (batch cap ~8 requests), 95th percentile token latency should remain under 260ms for their average prompt length — we'll need to confirm on the sample prompts in the attached workbook.
- Lead time: provisioning a dedicated pool and pinning model artifacts takes ~5 business days once finance signs off.

Recommendation: create a 30-day soft pre-hold for 15 H100-equivalent slots scoped to DEAL-9832 (us-west primary), and start pre-deployment of the customer model cand (quantized) into a staging pool so we can validate latency. I'll draft the runbook for activation and fallback.

– Marcus
Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Eliot Chang <eliot@peregrine.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2029 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Peregrine AI — request: preliminary sizing + pre-hold

Eliot —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Per our internal sizing scan (summary below), Redwood is prepared to place a 30-day soft pre-hold on a dedicated pool sized as follows while we finish the MOU and procurement: 15 H100-equivalent slots (primary: us-west). That includes a 20% buffer to cover weekend peaks and diagnostic runs.

Proposed mutual action plan (short):
1) Redwood: place 30-day soft pre-hold (15 H100-equivalents) scoped to DEAL-9832; spin up staging with your model artifacts for latency verification (3 business days).
2) Peregrine: share final throughput targets and sample prompts; provide SOC2 auditor contact for compliance review.
3) Legal/Finance: exchange draft MOU and expected PO timeline; aim to sign within 21 days to convert soft hold to reserved capacity.

Attached: redwood_prehold_mou.pdf (draft MOU / pre-hold outline).

If that aligns, we can confirm the soft hold today and kick off Marcus's runbook to stage the model. Can you confirm acceptance and whether you want us to increase the buffer to 30% instead of 20%?

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Dedicated & Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Eliot Chang <eliot@peregrine.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2029 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Peregrine AI — request: preliminary sizing + pre-hold

Ben / Jonas / Marcus —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Peregrine is comfortable with the proposed 15 H100-equivalent soft pre-hold, but we ask for a 30% buffer for the first 60 days (we have a hard traffic burst scheduled for a beta release). We will prioritize getting the SOC2 contact to you by EOD and will share a sample prompts set this afternoon.

Please go ahead and place the soft hold. We'll aim to finalize the MOU within two weeks; procurement is standing by. Also open to a short technical sync tomorrow to walk through the staging checklist and perf targets.

Eliot Chang
Head of Infrastructure, Peregrine AI
eliot@peregrine.ai
